text.text: The gunblade is an ancient weapon forged in one piece: a sword blade with a barrel running through its spine.
Landing a melee hit loads one round, up to three. Right-click fires a loaded round as a fast projectile that carries the tool's traits, at the cost of one durability.
Rounds are loaded only by striking enemies, so sustained fire depends on staying in melee range.
A gunblade cannot be built at a Tinker Station. They are recovered only from the chests of ancient cities.
